newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Mid-West spot power steady ahead of cold.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Mid-West spot power steady ahead of cold.

text.p: U.S. Midwestern spot wholesale electricity prices remained mostly steady Tuesday as traders looked for a forecast cold front to boost power demand in the region, industry sources said.
The Mid-Western prices were already seen as fairly strong following gains late last week and Monday in tandem with rising natural gas prices, the sources said.
Temperatures through much of the Mid-West were forecast to be below normal to much below through to about Nov 7.
Peak, non-firm power for Wednesday delivery in the Mid-Continent Area Power Pool (MAPP) region was quoted steady at $18.00-21.00 with very little spot business reported to be done, the sources said.
Off-peak non-firm MAPP power was said to be steady at $10.00-11.50 per megawatt hour (MWh).
In the Mid-American Interpool Network (MAIN), non-firm peak power was again talked close to MAPP prices, with Wednesday power pegged steady at $18.50-20.75, the brokers and marketers said.
Off-peak next day MAIN power was pegged steady at $12.00-14.00 per MWh.

Prices in the Southwest Power Pool (SPP) followed Texas power prices about $1 higher, with on-peak SPP power for Wednesday delivery discussed near $27.00 from about $26.00 per MWh on Monday, the sources said.
Off-peak prices in SPP were reported to be holding steady however in the $12.00-14.00 area, the sources said.
Peak November SPP power was said to be bid at $15.00, while December SPP was said to be bid at $16.00 and January/February discussed at $22.50-22.75 per MWh.

In the East Central Area Coordination Agreement (ECAR), peak, non-firm electricity prices for Wednesday delivery were assessed higher at $19.00-21.50 from a range of $16.50-20.00 on Monday, the sources said.
Off-peak next-day ECAR power was talked steady in the $12.50-14.00 area, the sources said.
November ECAR prices held steady at $17.00-17.40, while December was pegged steady at $18.70-19.10.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
